title: The Last Umbrella – Episode 1
logline: A stranger offers a soaked office worker the last umbrella at a bus stop – then reveals he knows her name.
style: Plain, realistic TV-drama look: overcast evening light, wet streets, true-to-life skin texture, muted colours, handheld 35mm, no glamour lighting.

characters.name: Mai
characters.description: Vietnamese woman, late 20s, shoulder-length black hair, light grey blazer over a white blouse, black trousers, canvas tote bag.

characters.name: Khoa
characters.description: Vietnamese man, early 30s, short neat hair, dark navy raincoat, carries a closed black umbrella.

locations.name: a city bus stop at dusk
locations.description: glass shelter with a metal bench, rain streaming off the roof, traffic lights blurred in the background.

shots.frame: Mai stands at the edge of the shelter, hair wet, holding her tote over her head.
shots.action: She checks her phone, sighs and looks up the road for the bus.

shots.frame: Khoa steps under the shelter beside Mai, rain dripping from his coat.
shots.action: Khoa holds out the closed umbrella to Mai without a word.
shots.speaker: khoa
shots.line: Take it. It's the last one.

shots.action: Mai hesitates, then takes the umbrella; Khoa smiles and steps back into the rain.
shots.speaker: khoa

shots.frame: Mai's face, frozen, the umbrella in her hands.
shots.action: Her eyes widen as she realises she never told him her name.
